jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building technology that connects the physical and digital worlds? Do you get excited about improving how smart home devices communicate and perform?

Alarm.com is looking for a Software Engineer II to join our Panels Team, where we develop and maintain the communication backbone powering millions of IoT devices worldwide.

In this role, you will design and deliver robust, scalable software solutions that enable seamless interoperability between devices, making homes smarter, safer, and more efficient.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand product requirements, innovate on solutions, and see your code in action with real hardware.

If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment and want to help shape the future of connected devices, we would love to hear from you.

Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. We are building a new team in Krakow. Our employees work fully from the office with possibility to work remotely occasionally.

What You Will Do

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack software for a wide range of platforms and technologies.
Research, evaluate, and integrate new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to solve complex technical challenges.
Participate in the full software development life cycle from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate with teams across the company to define solutions that meet both business and technical needs.
Balance speed and quality by knowing when to ship quickly and when to build for long-term stability.
Contribute ideas and insight to product development, not just implement specifications.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Two or more years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills with proficiency in C# preferred.
Experience with database design, SQL, and backend development.
Experience in the IoT and/or home automation field is a plus.
Experience writing and maintaining unit tests.
A curious mindset and a desire to continuously learn and improve.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

Collaborate with outstanding people: We have a strong focus on teamwork, and we work to create a collaborative and welcoming environment that enables our teams to excel.
Make an immediate impact: You can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You will be empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
Be Empowered: We don't want to micro-manage you. We want you to own stuff and bring your experience to make those products the best in class.
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package: including medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we're innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. We're seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

EBS Sp. z o.o. is a dynamically growing Polish technology company, combining decades of innovation with deep expertise in smart security solutions. We are part of the American corporation Alarm.com, a leading global provider of intelligent security solutions for homes and businesses.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com or ebssmart.com

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to, or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations, such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring compliance with labor laws and regulations, even after we have made our employment decision. We will retain this data for a maximum of 3 years after the end of the recruitment process. The data administrator is EBS Sp. z o.o.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Why A365 Software Engineering?

Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
Large-scale data processing; data modelling; holistic, intent-based API design
Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.

A day in the Life of our
Senior Software Engineer

Your primary role will be product development for complex cloud applications with the Altium 365 Platform team.

Technologies We Use

.NET Core, .NET Framework 4.8., MySQL
AWS cloud
Microservices
GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes.

Qualifications

What We're looking for

6+ years of .NET experience
Deep expertise in one or more of these areas:

identity and authentication, access or license management, message queues/brokers,

distributed caches, ElasticSearch/OpenSearch, relational database design and optimization,

platform framework development, multi-tenancy, Rings Protection Model in cloud development
Proven experience building and operating distributed, high-load systems, including performance profiling, optimisation, load testing, and stress testing
Strong ability to solve complex technical challenges that differ from typical market products, combining engineering software and cloud services
Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and drive architectural decisions
Experience defining and driving engineering standards, best practices, and technical governance at a platform level

Nice to have

Firebird, Oracle, Postgres.
Azure/GCP/AliCloud

Additional Information

Altium’s Website ( http://altium.com )
Altium Customer Stories ( https://www.youtube.com/@AltiumStories )

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Deca Food Tech oy is a technology-driven company focused on innovation in the food industry. The organization combines software engineering with food technology to improve efficiency, quality, and sustainability in food production and related processes. Deca Food Tech oy values practical problem-solving, collaboration, and the use of modern tools to address real-world industry challenges. Team members are encouraged to learn continuously and contribute to impactful solutions that support both business goals and customer needs.
Role Description
The Software Engineer internship role at Deca Food Tech oy is an on-site position based in Helsinki. The intern will assist in designing, implementing, and testing software components that support the company’s food tech solutions. Daily tasks may include writing clean and maintainable code, working on back-end services, debugging and resolving issues, and collaborating with senior engineers on feature development. The intern will also participate in code reviews, documentation, and the integration of software modules into existing systems. This internship provides hands-on experience in a collaborative environment and exposure to industry-relevant tools and practices.
Qualifications

Foundational knowledge in Computer Science and Software Development, including understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software life cycle.
Practical skills in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with experience in at least one common programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C#, or similar).
Basic experience or coursework in Back-End Web Development, such as working with APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Ability to analyze problems, propose solutions, and write clear, efficient, and well-documented code.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work in an on-site team environment in Helsinki.
Ongoing or completed studies in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Interest in the food tech domain and willingness to learn industry-specific tools and technologies.

jobs.title: .NET Developers with Experience in Health Data, Clinical Systems or Public Healthcare Platforms
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
About Twoday

Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologists, we collaborate with some of the most recognised private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise spans Data & AI, software development, digital experiences and business applications.

Our team operates across the Nordics and Lithuania, supporting more than 8,000 customers on their digital transformation journeys.

NET Developers with Experience in Health Data, Clinical Systems or Public Healthcare Platforms

Twoday is looking for both a Senior .NET Developer and a Junior .NET Developer (two to three years of relevant experience after your education) for a long-term public-sector healthcare project in Copenhagen.

You will join Twoday as a permanent employee and work closely with one of Denmark's most important public healthcare organisations on solutions that support healthcare professionals, health data and critical public services.

The role

You will contribute to the development, maintenance and modernisation of complex .NET solutions in a highly regulated environment.

Depending on your experience level, your responsibilities may include:

Developing and maintaining .NET-based applications and services
Designing and implementing integrations and APIs
Working with health data and business-critical workflows
Collaborating with architects, developers, product owners and stakeholders
Participating in code reviews, testing and quality assurance
Contributing to secure, maintainable and scalable solutions

Senior candidates are expected to take a larger role in technical decision-making, solution design and mentoring.

Required Experience

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience from one or more of the following areas:

Electronic Patient Record (EPR/EPJ) systems
Health data platforms
Clinical systems
Patient-related workflows
Healthcare authorities
Public healthcare platforms
Solutions used directly by healthcare professionals
Healthcare integrations and healthcare-related data flows

Experience from administrative solutions alone (e.g. workforce planning, payroll or HR systems for healthcare organisations) is not considered sufficient for this role.

Senior profile

You typically have:

Several years of experience with C# and .NET
Experience working with complex integrations and APIs
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Strong understanding of software quality, maintainability and security
Experience working with stakeholders in larger organisations

Junior profile

You typically have:

Two to three years of professional software development experience after having completed your education
Experience with C# and .NET
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Understanding of APIs, databases and modern development practices
Desire to develop further in a strong professional environment

Technical environment

Experience with some of the following is expected:

C# / .NET
REST APIs
SQL Server
Entity Framework
Azure DevOps
CI/CD
Integration development
Automated testing

Language Requirements

Fluent Danish, both written and spoken, is required.

Location

The role is primarily onsite in the Copenhagen area.

Why Twoday

At Twoday, you will join one of the leading digital transformation partners in the Nordics and become part of a strong professional community where knowledge sharing, collaboration and continuous development are central.

What We Offer

Permanent employment with Twoday
Opportunity to work on meaningful, high-impact public sector solutions
Professional development in a strong technical environment
A collaborative and supportive team culture

If you are interested in contributing to impactful healthcare solutions and working closely with a key public sector client, we would love to hear from you.

The process

Telephone interview with a Talent Acquisition Partner
Teams interview with hiring manager
Technical assessment
Onsite interview with hiring manager

About Twoday

Twoday has modern offices in more than 30 locations across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Lithuania. We offer an engaging work environment with high professional standards and a strong sense of community. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally in an international and innovative organisation.

Diversity & Inclusion

Don’t meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace, and we encourage you to apply if the role interests you – even if your experience does not match the job description perfectly.
